workload.description: One capability file in the project. 160 is a large application's worth of capabilities; 640 a large monorepo's. The ladder stops at 2,560, not 10,240, because every size writes a real project of TypeScript files and links them with the TypeScript compiler API, which takes minutes at the largest sizes.

contribution.description: Once at the start of every artifact generation.
Once per artifact run; every artifact is rendered from this one shared pass.
